mentions.name: One-Article-Per-Day Reading App
mentions.description: Android app that helps users actually read what they save by allowing only one saved article per day; finishing today's read unlocks the next one. Twitter, Reddit, and other posts can be saved separately and revisited anytime. Currently validating interest, with a planned small closed beta for Android.
mentions.problem: The builder keeps saving blogs and articles but almost never revisits them.
mentions.audience: Personal use for people who hoard saved articles
mentions.source_excerpt: So I’m building an Android app designed to help me actually read what I save. You only get one saved article per day. Finish today’s read to unlock the next one. You can also save Twitter, Reddit, etc. posts separately and revisit them anytime.
mentions.author: kvh00
